newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Port conditions update - S.Korea - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - S.Korea - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service -
Busan, Dec 30 - 241 vessels in port, 62 at berth and 179 at anchorage. Usually three to four days delay due to berth congestion.
Ulsan - 120 vessels in port, 80 at berth and 40 at anchorage. One to two days delay due to berth congestion.
Pohang - 63 vessels in port, 24 at berth and 39 at anchorage. One to two days delay due to berth congestion.
Inchon - 66 vessels in port, 52 at berth and 14 at anchorage. One to two days delay due to berth congestion.
